physical_inputs.T_reheat: value, units and thermal-history model; temperature alone does not fix reheating history
physical_inputs.initial_distributions: f_N, daughter and SM distributions at declared initial surface
physical_inputs.microphysics: masses, Dirac/Majorana, flavor mixing, operators, mediator masses/couplings and dark-SM interactions
physical_inputs.daughter_sector_content: species, masses, interactions and stable/unstable nature
physical_inputs.widths_branching_spectra: partial widths, branching fractions and daughter spectra derived from same model, with thresholds
physical_inputs.background_model: a,H,T_gamma and entropy history with consistent gstar_energy/gstar_entropy

derived_diagnostics.production_regime: freeze-in/freeze-out/mixed or none; inferred from kinetic history, not an independent switch granting BBN safety
derived_diagnostics.production_history: f_N(p,t), yields, production/inverse/scattering/decay terms; Gamma_prod/H over full accessible history is diagnostic, not proof at one time
derived_diagnostics.energy_return_history: Q to electromagnetic/neutrino/dark sectors; energy_return_epoch is a stated summary of this history
derived_diagnostics.entropy_dilution_history: derived from common energy/entropy evolution, not independent double-counted nuisance
derived_diagnostics.gstar_at_decoupling: evaluate at derived decoupling if that epoch exists; otherwise not applicable

kinetic_convention: (partial_t-H p partial_p) f_N = C_prod+ C_scatt+ C_inverse+ C_decay, each term signed consistently with detailed balance; expansion included explicitly.
required_outputs: f_nue, f_antinue and consistent weak rates
BBN abundances in declared common solver regime
source_scope: HNL_DARK_V3 Appendix B uses freeze-out analytic approximations; Appendix C states its numerical code includes both freeze-in and freeze-out. Do not label the whole paper freeze-out-only.
inference_boundaries: Dark daughters can retain energy or return it to SM; direction of constraint depends on model/history.
Freeze-in or low reheating is not unconditional exclusion clearance; late injection/photodisintegration and cosmological consistency remain.
Sub-GeV/GeV benchmarks do not automatically provide a 20–75 GeV exclusion.
Proper lifetime and detector displacement alone do not give a cosmological abundance or BBN verdict.
mapping_to_architecture: Optional realization of X_MICROPHYSICS feeding COSMOLOGICAL_BACKGROUND and NEUTRINO_KINETIC_BRIDGE; HNL is not required for all standard BBN controls.
